sentences.en: Tartiflette is a delicious potatoe and reblochon cheese based dish.
sentences.zh: 塔蒂弗莱特是一种美味的土豆和瑞布洛香奶酪菜肴。

sentences.en: The apples which he sent to me were delicious.
sentences.zh: 他寄给我的苹果非常可口。

sentences.en: The lunch she brought to me was as delicious as rumoured.
sentences.zh: 她带给我的午餐果然名不虚传，十分美味。

senses.zh: 美味的，可口的 - 令人开心的，怡人的 - (人际关系中的)技巧和谨慎；敏感
